facts.fact: HeadingPath joins nested heading titles with " > ", e.g. "Guide > Setup > Docker".
Markdown heading starts new chunk only after current chunk reaches MinFill; shorter content merges with next heading's section.
Fenced code blocks (``` and ~~~~) never split across chunks, including blank lines inside.
Shorter ~~~ line inside ~~~~ fence does not close fence.
ChunkMarkdown returns first-level heading as title.
Document without first-level heading returns empty title from ChunkMarkdown.
Oversized paragraph split at lines, then sentences, then runes; no text lost.
Tail chunk below Budget.MinTail tokens merges back into previous chunk.
Chunk.Context is previous chunk's tail, cut at line start.
ChunkText splits on blank lines only, no heading parsing, so HeadingPath empty.
Chunking loses or duplicates no text, ignoring whitespace.
Chunking Budget fields: Target, Max, MinFill, MinTail, Context.
